41597.explanation:

E = I(R + r) 

0.5 = 50 x 10\(^{-3}\)(8 + x)

8 + x = \(\frac{0.5}{50 \times 10^{-3}}\)

8 + x = 10

x = 10 - 8 = 2 \(\Omega\)
